text:
sam: heads-up — got an escalations issue from customer: operator requested P1 escalation but our autorouter invoked log_note instead of escalate_incident, so no paging went out :rotating_light:

sam: minimal repro below, customer payload ->
```json
POST /v1/assistant/call
{
  "input": "Please escalate ticket TCK-492 to P1 and page on-call",
  "tool_autoroute": true,
  "tools": ["log_note", "escalate_incident", "add_label"]
}
```

sam: response we returned ->
```json
{
  "selected_tool": "log_note",
  "args": {"ticket_id":"TCK-492","note":"Escalation requested: P1"}
}
```

alex: ack — thanks for the repro. Do we have the decision trace for routing? can dev-bot paste?

dev-bot: routing-trace for thread 1923456789:
- match score log_note: 0.87
- match score escalate_incident: 0.65
- key cue used: presence of word "escalate" matched both; but heuristic prioritized shorter arg match

maria: hmm looks like we weight 'arg shape match' over 'action verbs'. escalate_incident expects {ticket_id, priority, notify_ops:true} but customer omitted notify_ops so score dropped.

jordan: short-term patch: bump escalate_incident base score when 'priority' token appears and/or require 'notify_ops' default to true when priority==P1. Longer-term: update autorouter to consider imperative verbs.

sam: can we hotfix today? customer is sitting on P1 and there's no paging. Any rollback risk? :grimacing:

alex: low risk. I'll push a small heuristic change to autorouter config to prefer tools whose schema contains 'priority' when text includes P1/P0. deploy in staging -> quick smoke -> prod if green. ETA 30m.

maria: capture test case in tests/autoroute/coverage: add sample with "Please escalate ... P1" expecting escalate_incident. I'll add.

sam: thanks — keep me posted. tagging @oncall because paging failed. :pray:

jordan: also adding a regression alert to catch future no-paging outcomes (check for selected_tool == log_note when text contains 'page' or 'page on-call').

sam: noted, moving to ops.
